# ReLU.chat

> Free, browser-based, privacy-first open-source chatbots that run entirely in your browser. No servers, no LLMs, no tracking.

## Overview

ReLU.chat is an open-source platform for interactive on-device chatbots. All NLP processing happens in the browser using quantized ONNX models (~22MB). The system uses sentence transformers for 384-dimensional embeddings, BM25 sparse retrieval, dense cosine similarity, and a reinforcement-learning-trained MLP policy network.

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://relu.chat/) — Landing page with feature overview
- [How It Works](https://relu.chat/how-it-works.html) — Full technical architecture
- [Blog](https://relu.chat/blog/) — Technical articles on on-device AI and NLP

## Architecture

- **Loading**: Progressive — heuristic/BOW fallback + memoization for instant first turns; ~22 MB MiniLM + KB embeddings hot-swap once ready (Service Worker pre-caches)
- **Embedding**: all-MiniLM-L6-v2 (quantized ONNX, 384-dim) with query embedding LRU
- **Retrieval**: BM25 sparse + dense cosine similarity ensemble + top-k ranking (no full sort)
- **Policy**: MLP 25→128→64→6 action heads, RL-trained; local shadow compare vs heuristic
- **Composition**: Fragment assembly with linguistic connectors + cross-fragment semantic dedup
- **Session**: Rich history + EMA summary vector for multi-turn context + follow-up/topic correction
- **Runtime**: Pure browser JavaScript, WebAssembly, ONNX Runtime, Service Worker + Cache API
- **Storage**: Client-side only (IndexedDB + Cache API, no server state)
